title: A zero-order reaction
caption: The concentration falls at a constant rate, so the graph is a straight line whose gradient is −k. Here k = 0.05 mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹: the half-life, [A]₀/2k = 10 s, gets shorter as the reaction goes on.
alt: [A] against time: a straight line from 1.0 mol dm⁻³ at 0 s to zero at 20 s.
description: A straight line: the rate does not depend on [A].
Half the reactant is gone at 10 s.
